item.stem:
Meera lists four substances found in her kitchen and at home.

She knows that a compound forms when different elements are chemically joined together, so the new substance has properties different from those of its elements and cannot be separated by physical means.

Which substances are compounds?

| substance | W | X | Y | Z |
| description | common salt, made by joining sodium and chlorine | air, a mixture of gases that keep their own properties | copper wire, made of only one element | sugar, made by joining carbon, hydrogen and oxygen |
